pub fn manifest_with_pinned_versions() -> &'static str {
    r#"[package]
name = \"my-app\"
version = \"0.1.0\"

[dependencies]
serde = \"1.0\"
tokio = \"1.28\"
"#
}

pub fn has_pinned_versions() -> bool {
    let text = manifest_with_pinned_versions();
    text.contains("serde = \"1.0\"") && text.contains("tokio = \"1.28\"")
}
